name: @craftsmen/asyncapi-kafka-spring-template
description: AsyncAPI Generator template that produces the Spring Cloud Stream Kafka binder config, the publisher/consumer class and the Java record/enum models for one AsyncAPI operation.

scripts.test: npm run test:order-service && npm run test:stock-service

javaPackage.description: Java package for the generated record/enum models

messagingPackage.description: Java package for the generated publisher/consumer class

javaSourceRoot.description: Root folder Java sources are written under, e.g. target/generated-sources/asyncapi-template to keep generated code out of src/main/java

resourcesRoot.description: Root folder the Kafka binder config is written under, e.g. target/generated-resources to keep it out of src/main/resources
